target.title: refactor(ui): trim private search exports
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Control UI settings-search refactor exposed two module-local type aliases and a redundant test-only forwarding export. The stale surface caused the unused-export ratchet to fail on current `main`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the helper types private to the search module, remove the forwarding export from the renderer module, and have the focused test import from the canonical owner module. Runtime search behavior is unchanged.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change. The Control UI internal API is smaller, and the dead-code export ratchet is green again.

## Evidence

- Exact-main codebase-memory graph: 305,953 nodes / 1,267,110 edges; branch graph: 305,972 nodes / 1,267,415 edges.
- `pnpm --dir ui test src/components/config-form.search.node.test.ts src/pages/config/settings-search.test.ts`: 2 files, 11 tests passed on Testbox `tbx_01kxc1px5f25gz4w2yxh1e6664`.
- `node scripts/check-deadcode-exports.mjs`: baseline matched 5,964 entries.
- Scoped `pnpm check:changed -- ui/src/components/config-form.node.ts ui/src/components/config-form.search.ts ui/src/components/config-form.search.node.test.ts`: passed on the same Testbox.
- `pnpm build`: passed on Testbox `tbx_01kxc28wc2hm4bmm7vwavcpess`, including the Control UI build and public plugin SDK declaration graph ([run 29208913345](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29208913345)).
- Fresh `gpt-5.6-sol` medium autoreview: local clean at 0.96; branch clean at 0.94.
